additional_concerns: Neither candidate has executable meaning. The unsupported LegalRuleML result and retrieval rankings establish no semantic correspondence or legal compliance.

The source does not establish a complete test equating retained accountability with allocation, actual authority and consistent conduct, or substantive fulfillment with a specified conjunction of authority, supervision and satisfactory outcomes. These are proposed assessment approaches requiring justification.

The allocation candidate expressly leaves supervisory discharge unresolved. Retained accountability must not silently become certification of operational soundness; conversely, paper allocation alone does not establish effective retention.

No actual arrangement facts, assessment period, severity threshold or remediation standard are supplied. Missing evidence and individual service failures cannot automatically produce a false fulfillment result.

The complete requirements of paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. Paragraph 13 of the separate Tokenised Securities Circular is not a substitute for the missing incorporated provisions.

Paragraph 15 concerns requested third-party audit or verification of three specified subjects. Paragraph 16 concerns a requested satisfactory legal opinion supporting the application. Neither imposes procurement solely because no request has been made.

The supplied intermediary issuance provision supports continued responsibility despite outsourcing within its own scope. It does not automatically establish the Product Provider's supervisory standard or make intermediary satisfaction equivalent to SFC satisfaction.

authority.rationale: The retained-responsibility claim itself needs no additional authority; a complete substantive fulfillment standard remains unresolved.

executable_correspondence.rationale: The substantive-performance candidate supplies no executable expression for this relevant responsibility.

followup_questions: What executable formalization and applicable substantive standard will distinguish retained responsibility, supervisory conduct and operational outcomes without treating every incident as failure?
